description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans localhost clustering mode, including single-silo and multi-silo configurations, verifying cluster startup, silo discovery, client connectivity, and grain communication.

classes.name: LocalhostClusterTests
classes.description: Contains tests for Orleans localhost clustering, including single and multi-silo scenarios.

methods.name: LocalhostSiloTest
methods.description: Tests that a single silo configured with localhost clustering can start, accept grain calls, and be connected to by a client.

methods.name: LocalhostClusterTest
methods.description: Tests that multiple silos can form a cluster on localhost, discover each other, and support client connections with high availability.
